# SatelliteGuys.US

> America's largest satellite technology forum community dedicated to DISH Network, DIRECTV, and satellite TV discussions.

SatelliteGuys.US is a comprehensive community platform where satellite TV enthusiasts, customers, and industry professionals discuss service issues, programming changes, equipment sales, and technical support. The site serves as a central hub for DISH Network and DIRECTV customer support, marketplace transactions, and real-time community engagement.

## Key Topics

- DISH Network
- DIRECTV
- Satellite TV
- Community Forum
- Customer Support
- NFL Sunday Ticket
- Equipment Classifieds
- Forum Discussion
- Member Community
- Service Outages
- Channel Blackouts
- Satellite Technology
- User Profiles
- Forum Activity

## Main Forums

- [DISH Network Support Forum](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/forums/dish-network-support-forum.10): Main forum for DISH Network support, programming, and service discussions
- [DIRECTV General Forum](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/forums/directv-general-forum.11): Main forum for DIRECTV support, general discussion, and customer help
- [SatelliteGuys Classifieds](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/forums/satelliteguys-classifieds.12): Classifieds marketplace for buying and selling satellite equipment and electronics

## Community Hub

- [SatelliteGuys.US Homepage](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen): Homepage for SatelliteGuys.US, America's largest satellite technology forum community
- [Latest Posts](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/whats-new/posts): Latest forum posts and activity from SatelliteGuys.US community discussions
- [Featured Content](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/featured): Featured content and highlighted discussions on SatelliteGuys.US forum
- [Current Visitors](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/online): Real-time display of currently online users on SatelliteGuys.US forum

## Community Members

- [Notable Members Directory](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/members): Directory of notable and active members in SatelliteGuys.US community
- [Member Map](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/dbtech-membermap): Geographical map showing locations of SatelliteGuys.US forum members

## Forum Tools & Support

- [Create New Thread](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/forums/-/create-thread): Forum thread creation interface for DISH, DIRECTV, and satellite discussions
- [SatelliteGuys Support Center](https://www.satelliteguys.us/xen/forums/satelliteguys-support-center.9): Support forum for SatelliteGuys website issues, bugs, and feature requests
